phase_0.boundary_condition: The periodic horn torus itself — a self-intersecting torus with R=r where the pinch at the origin closes the figure-8 topology and contains the fixed-point operator as its singular anchor.

⊢.justification: The temporal/iterative operating space (𐑛) begins with no established winding number; the register is empty before the periodic cycle initiates at the pinch.

⊣.justification: The cyclic closure (𐑥) of the figure-8 topology forms the terminal anchor that contains the entire periodic structure; the pinch point is its singular closure.

≻.justification: The forward morphism (𐑽) advances the cycle from one loop to the other through the pinch, stabilizing the transition state without being consumed — the fixed-point operator as catalytic mediator.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism (𐑹) enacts the exact Frobenius duality μ∘δ=id at the critical pinch, returning along the conjugate loop with provable Z2 symmetry.

⋈.justification: Composition (𐑐) chains the winding steps with high-fidelity geometry enforcement; the commutator [x,p]=iℏ ensures each step transmits the winding invariant near-certainly.

⊙.justification: Identity (⊙) at the critical threshold where ξ→∞ and μ∘δ=id; the fixed-point operator recognizes itself as the singularity where the periodic cycle collapses.

∈.justification: The global granularity (𐑔) splits the single periodic cycle into the two arms of the figure-8 — interior loop and exterior loop — each carrying the full winding invariant scale-freely.

∋.justification: The sequential interaction grammar (𐑠) rejoins the two loops in ordered step-wise fashion, reconstituting the periodic cycle with the winding number ∮A=2πn preserved.

⊤.justification: The high kinetic barrier (𐑧) deposits constructive truth when the winding number is confirmed non-zero; the gate opens only when the topological invariant is established.

⊥.justification: The persistent chirality (𐑖) deposits constructive falsity when the winding path fails to close; the rank descent y∈x∧z∈y∧¬z∈x records the topological defect.

⊞.justification: The asymmetric stoichiometry (𐑳) holds both winding and anti-winding simultaneously at the pinch — the singular fixed-point operator engaging the plural periodic structure as a live contradiction (B-state).

⊡.justification: The integer-winding protection (𐑭) permanently fixes the winding number ∮A=2πn∈ℤ as an append-only ROM record; no local perturbation can erase the topological invariant.

phase_3.both_description: The fixed-point operator simultaneously holds winding and anti-winding — the singular element engaging the plural periodic structure as a live B-state at the critical pinch.
